verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-sending service, but the evidence only describes Resend as a hosted API reached at api.resend.com and smtp.resend.com, with infrastructure Resend itself manages. The open-source MCP server repo and the CLI are ancillary tools, not a self-hostable core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
